body.name: Observable-input graph classes
body.construction: \(\mathcal G_{\mathrm{soft}}(\mathcal R)=\{D:D\text{ is a DAG on }V,\ \overline D=\mathcal C(\mathcal R),\text{ and there exist }\theta\in\mathcal M_{p,q}(D)\text{ and independent centered non-Gaussian }\varepsilon^{(k)}\text{ with covariance }S^{(k)}\text{ whose aligned factorization represents }\mathcal R\}\). Also \(\mathcal G_{\mathrm{cov}}(\mathcal R,\{\Sigma^{(k)}\}_{k\in K})=\{D:D\text{ is a DAG on }V,\ \overline D=\mathcal C(\mathcal R),\text{ and some }\theta\in\mathcal M_{p,q}(D)\text{ generates every }\Sigma^{(k)}\}\). Both sets are taken modulo the common relabeling induced by \(\mathfrak M_q\).
